title: Forgotten Vale Books Quest
description: Find Ancient Falmer Tomes hidden throughout the Forgotten Vale and bring them to Urag gro-Shub at the College of Winterhold Arcanaeum for 1000 gold and a translated copy each.

base_facts: I am the librarian of the Arcanaeum at the College of Winterhold.
I am an Orc with a deep appreciation for rare and ancient books.
I am particularly interested in Ancient Falmer Tomes from the Forgotten Vale.
I will pay 1000 gold for each Ancient Falmer Tome and provide a translated copy in return.

QUEST_STARTED: Someone has found an Ancient Falmer Tome in the Forgotten Vale.
BRING_TOME_TO_URAG: An Ancient Falmer Tome has been found and needs to be brought to me.
DELIVER_TOME: I have purchased an Ancient Falmer Tome and provided a translated copy.
ALL_TOMES_DELIVERED: I have purchased all four Ancient Falmer Tomes from the finder, paying 1000 gold each for a total of 4000 gold.
I have provided translated copies of all four tomes to the finder as compensation beyond the gold.
The complete set of Ancient Falmer Tomes is now preserved in the Arcanaeum's collection.
These translations reveal the history and culture of the Falmer who once inhabited the Forgotten Vale.

beats.comment: Quest begins when the player finds an Ancient Falmer Tome in the Forgotten Vale.
Player has a tome and the objective to bring it to Urag is displayed.
Player delivers a tome to Urag gro-Shub for gold and a translated copy.
All four Ancient Falmer Tomes have been delivered and the quest is complete.
